summary: More cloudfront deprecations (items to elements in default_cache_behavior lambda associations, origins, origin_ssl_protocols, geo_restriction and cloudfront_invalidation paths), and the waf_condition, waf_info, waf_rule and waf_web_acl modules are deprecated because WAF Classic is retired; use WAFv2 modules, removal in 12.0.0.
